Hippocampal volume may be a key marker of or risk factor for depressive symptomology, but volume does not appear to relate significantly to change in depressive symptomology over this relatively short interval.

description.value: Event-related facial emotion processing task in which children viewed facial expressions and decided whether each face was male or female.

stimuli.value: Faces from the MacArthur Network Face Stimuli Set showing neutral and 50% and 100% sad, fearful, angry, and happy expressions from 10 individuals.

spans.text: emotion reactivity network

description.value: Network including bilateral amygdala and regions showing positive resting-state functional connectivity with the amygdala, including hippocampal, parahippocampal, striatal, and temporal regions.

spans.text: emotion regulation network

description.value: Network including dorsal frontal and parietal regions showing negative resting-state functional connectivity with the amygdala.
